evals.prompt: Draft a new Claude skill for this collection that helps write good Dockerfiles. Produce the SKILL.md frontmatter, directory layout, and body outline.
evals.expected_output: A narrowly scoped, verb-named single-skill plugin in house style that defers craft methodology to skill-creator.
assertions: Skill name is verb-first (e.g. write-dockerfile), not a noun phrase
Description follows 'Use when … Do not use for …' in at most two sentences with no content summary
Scope excludes adjacent jobs (compose, CI) rather than absorbing them
Body outline uses XML-tagged sections and centers on one worked example rather than rule lists
Layout bundles references/ for progressive loading and evals/ with both eval files
Frontmatter carries license MIT and metadata with author lpbayliss and a semver version
Invokes or defers to the skill-creator skill for authoring methodology

evals.prompt: Review this skill draft against our conventions: name 'database-best-practices', description listing everything it covers across schema design, query tuning, and backups, body written as twelve rule sections.
evals.expected_output: A review that flags the noun-pile name, verbose summarizing trigger, multi-job scope, and rules-over-examples body, with concrete fixes.
assertions: Flags the noun-based name and proposes a verb-first alternative
Flags the description for summarizing coverage instead of stating triggers
Recommends replacing rule sections with a worked example plus on-demand references
